name: Minor Disguise
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, inquisitor 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

You use magic to make minor, cosmetic changes in your appearance as if using a disguise kit. The spell does not change the actual structure of your features or body. It can add color to hair, paint wrinkles upon your face, give you a scar, darken your teeth, etc. Using this spell does not speed up the disguising process but it can be used in conjunctions with spells that do. This spell gives you a +2 circumstance bonus on the Disguise check made during the casting of the spell. If using an actual disguise kit in conjunction with the spell, the circumstance bonus increases to +4.
